LESSON: PRAYER CHURCH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 5.1: Prayer Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Prayer Church. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. narrate the story of a friend at midnight 44 and apply it in their lives
2. desire to pray regularly to develop a relationship with God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. narrate the story of a friend at midnight 44 and apply it in their lives
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to narrate the story of a friend at midnight 44 and apply it in their lives. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. desire to pray regularly to develop a relationship with God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to pray regularly to develop a relationship with God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Prayer Church.
2. Explain Prayer Church to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Prayer Church.
4. Show that you can: narrate the story of a friend at midnight 44 and apply it in their lives
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Prayer Church. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Prayer Church important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. narrate the story of a friend at midnight 44 and apply it in their lives
2. desire to pray regularly to develop a relationship with God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
